scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @prediction-evaluator/api && npm run build -w @prediction-evaluator/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @prediction-evaluator/core && npm run test -w @prediction-evaluator/api

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @prediction-evaluator/api
